<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/observability/metrics/">Metrics</a><span class="nv-section-count">10</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">Three verbs for three kinds, nine series that exist the moment an exporter is configured, and a name fixed to one kind for good.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/metrics/#the-runtime-exports-what-it-already-measures">Production telemetry is read from the instrumentation that already exists, and <section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/">Traces and spans</a><span class="nv-section-count">17</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">Exactly four things become a span, an inbound <code>traceparent</code> is continued, and sampling is decided once at the root.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#four-kinds-become-a-span">Exactly four things become a span, and a <code>call</code> event never does</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#a-call-never-becomes-a-span">A <code>call</code> event never becomes a span; the root, a <code>query</code>, an outbound HTTP call and a <code>spawn</code> do, and <code>gc</code> becomes a metric</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="designed">Designed</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#trace-events-carry-a-kind">A trace event carries one of five kinds — <code>call</code>, <code>gc</code>, <code>spawn</code>, <code>query</code>, <code>http</code> — and a <code>call</code> keeps its probe shape</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#a-query-is-a-trace-event">A statement is a <code>query</code> trace event that carries its duration, driver, connection, truncated SQL and row counts, and never a bound parameter</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#a-slow-query-is-logged-past-a-threshold">A <code>[db.&lt;name&gt;] slow_query</code> threshold writes a statement's span facts to <code>Core\Log</code>, and is off until a block writes one</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#gc-pause-is-its-own-event">A collector pause is a <code>gc</code> event recorded from the collector's run routine, never from the safepoint poll</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="designed">Designed</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#spawn-is-its-own-event">A spawn and its join are one <code>spawn</code> event naming the form it was, with an overhead split where the child reports its own time, and a child's own stream never crosses live</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/traces/#an-inbound-traceparent-is-continued">An inbound <code>traceparent</code> is continued, and one the process <section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/observability/exit-hooks/">Exit hooks</a><span class="nv-section-count">5</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">A request-local hook that observes how the request ended and never steers it — and the two endings that fire no hook at all.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/exit-hooks/#script-on-exit"><code>Core\Script::onExit</code> registers a request-local hook that runs FIFO as the last user code, and each hook receives one readonly <code>ExitReport</code></a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/exit-hooks/#three-endings-fire-the-exit-queue">The exit queue drains once — at a normal end, at <code>exit</code> and at an uncaught throw — and the report says which ending it was</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/exit-hooks/#exit-hooks-run-after-the-ladder-before-teardown">Exit hooks run after every <code>finally</code> and after the failure hooks, and before native teardown, with the heap alive and output where it was</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/exit-hooks/#a-fatal-and-a-cancellation-run-no-exit-hook">A <code>FATAL</code> and a cancellation run no exit hook — <code>Core\Fatal::onLimit</code> is the one observer of a limit breach</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/observability/exit-hooks/#a-hook-observes-and-never-steers">A hook observes the ending and never steers it: the report is fixed first, a throw is logged and abandoned, <code>exit</code> inside a hook throws, and the drain continues</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li></ol>
</section>
